patch_description:
This implementation reformulates the minimax KVPR objective as a sequence of bin-packing feasibility tests. For a target pressure `T`, a GPU satisfies `load / remaining <= T` exactly when the sum of transformed item costs `weight + T * size` is at most `80 * T`. This converts the ratio-balancing problem into scalar capacity packing.

The algorithm binary-searches the smallest feasible pressure and uses several deterministic best-fit packing orders at each threshold. This is fundamentally different from direct greedy KVPR placement and local move/swap descent: it searches the objective value globally, while the packing routine constructs a placement that proves feasibility for that value.
